shortDescription: Create or delete uptime check alerts

options.name: check_id
options.description: The unique identifier of the uptime check.

options.name: client_override_options
options.description: Client override options (developer use). For example, can be used to override the DigitalOcean API endpoint for an internal test suite. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: comparison
options.description: The comparison operator for the threshold.

options.name: id
options.description: The unique identifier of the alert. Used for lookup when updating or deleting.

options.name: module_override_options
options.description: Module override options (developer use). Can be used to override module options to support experimental or future options. If provided, these options will knock out existing options.

options.name: period
options.description: The period of time the threshold must be breached to trigger the alert.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the resource, C(present) to create, C(absent) to destroy.

options.name: threshold
options.description: The threshold at which the alert triggers. For latency alerts, this is in milliseconds. For ssl_expiry alerts, this is in days.

options.name: token
options.description: DigitalOcean API token. There are several environment variables which can be used to provide this value. C(DIGITALOCEAN_ACCESS_TOKEN), C(DIGITALOCEAN_TOKEN), C(DO_API_TOKEN), C(DO_API_KEY), C(DO_OAUTH_TOKEN) and C(OAUTH_TOKEN)
